The '''Xanas system''' was a part of the [[Xan sector/Legends|Xan sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[City/Legends|settlement]] known as [[Xanas City]] as well as the region known as [[West County]].<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xanas City, and therefore the Xanas [[Star system/Legends|system]], appeared in "[[A Pleasure Doing Business With You&hellip;]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] subsequently named the system and placed it in grid square Q-15.<ref name="TEA" />
